claims.statement: For EXC-0921 split-reservation orders, carrier confirmations arrive a median of 47 minutes after booking, but pickup slots close after 30 minutes
claims.limitation: Median arrival time; some confirmations may arrive earlier or later

claims.statement: East-node orders outside EXC-0921 that were booked before 05:58 were confirmed within their 30-minute slot window
claims.limitation: Comparison group; suggests the issue is specific to split-reservation orders or their routing

claims.statement: One EXC-0921 order that was re-booked after carrier data refreshed received a valid slot and was confirmed
claims.limitation: Single case, but confirms that extended slots or re-booking resolves the issue

claims.statement: Rule v18's split-reservation orders take a median of 47 minutes for carrier confirmation after booking, which exceeds the 30-minute pickup slot validity window, causing orders to remain stuck in 'allocated, awaiting pickup'
claims.limitation: The underlying cause of the 47-minute confirmation lag is not yet determined; could be carrier-side delay, data transmission, or integration queue depth

claims.statement: Carrier feed or pickup scheduling has a lag or failure in recognizing the east-node-prioritized allocations from rule v18
claims.limitation: Confirmed by timing data; the 47-minute confirmation lag is the specific failure mode

claims.statement: 186 orders (100% of overnight EXC-0921 allocations) are held indefinitely because their carrier confirmations cannot arrive before slot closure
claims.limitation: Impact will persist until slot window is extended or confirmation latency is reduced

next_action.rationale: The root cause is a timing mismatch: split-reservation order confirmations require 47 minutes (median) but slots close after 30 minutes. The most direct, reversible mitigation is to extend the pickup slot window for EXC-0921 orders from 30 to 50+ minutes, allowing confirmations to arrive before slot closure. This is authorized as a single reversible action and requires no upstream rule changes or rollbacks.
